summary:
v0.2.6.1 (leaderboard upsert + name conflict + guest + admin delete) end-to-end PASSED on both backend and frontend.

BACKEND (8/8 new + 22/22 retained):
- Created /app/backend/tests/test_v0261_leaderboard.py.
- POST /api/leaderboard official: same name (different case + extra spaces) + same owner_token: 90 -> 'created', 95 -> 'updated' (id reused, total_score=95), 50 -> 'kept' (message contains 'still 95', total_score still 95). Name comparison is case-insensitive + space-normalized.
- Conflict: same name with a DIFFERENT owner_token returns status='conflict', entry null, suggestions length 3 (variants like NAME_01, NAMECloud, NAME_Forge); no duplicate row in GET (still 1 row with original score).
- Guest mode always inserts a SEPARATE entry with mode='guest' and does not overwrite the official personal best (verified via GET).
- Owner delete: DELETE /api/leaderboard/{id}?owner_token=WRONG -> 403; correct owner_token -> 200 {deleted:true,id}; subsequent DELETE -> 404.
- Admin delete: no X-Admin-Token -> 403; wrong token -> 403; correct ADMIN_TOKEN (cf-admin-7Qx2Lm9Tv) -> 200 {deleted:true}. There is NO public delete-all: DELETE /api/leaderboard returns 405.
- GET /api/leaderboard sanitizer: no '_id', no 'owner_token', no 'name_key' fields leaked; mode is one of {'official','guest'}.
- Scoring engine unchanged: python /app/backend/tests/test_scoring.py reports 5/5 cases pass; static_blog s3+cloudfront+route53 still 90/Well-Architected with the six v0.2.5 sub-scores intact (Correct=30, Ideal=25, Constraint=10, Synergy=15, Simplicity=10, Explanation=0).

FRONTEND (Playwright):
- Final summary save-mode choice: data-testid='save-section' renders save-mode-choice with save-mode-official selected by default (highlight class bg-[#7E1818]/15 present), save-mode-guest available.
- Official save via UI -> 'New personal best saved for X' toast, localStorage cf_my_score persisted with mode='official' and matching id.
- Same browser (same cf_owner_token) replays: lower score keeps best (status='kept', total stays at prior best); higher score upgrades (status='updated', same id, new total).
- Conflict UI: pre-seeded the name under a different owner via API, then attempted save from the UI -> name-suggestions box appeared with exactly 3 clickable suggestion chips (NAME_01, NAMECloud, NAME_Forge); clicking a chip fills leaderboard-name-input and hides the box; saving with the suggested name succeeds and writes cf_my_score.
- /leaderboard: my-score-panel + delete-my-score-button + leaderboard-row-mine highlight present; ZERO interactive delete controls on other rows before admin activation.
- Admin panel: collapsible 'Admin cleanup' (data-testid=admin-panel) with admin-token-input + admin-token-submit. Pasting cf-admin-7Qx2Lm9Tv activates admin mode (admin-panel-active visible), admin-delete-<id> appears on EVERY row (10 rows tested). Token is written to sessionStorage (key cf_admin_token = 'cf-admin-7Qx2Lm9Tv') and NOT to localStorage. admin-exit-button removes the sessionStorage key and de-activates admin mode.
- delete-my-score-button: window.confirm accepted via page.once('dialog'); backend entry removed, my-score-panel disappears, localStorage cf_my_score cleared.
- flock-greeting still renders 'Welcome back, {name}. Ready to forge another architecture?' when cf_player_name is set.
- Mobile portrait 390x844: /play and /leaderboard both have document.documentElement.scrollWidth==innerWidth (no horizontal page overflow). Desktop 1920x800 /play renders side-by-side two-column layout (aside x=344 w=395, main x=763 w=813).
- Guest label visible on leaderboard table for rows where mode='guest'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py add_leaderboard scans the WHOLE leaderboard collection in-memory (find({}).to_list(1000)) for every official save to do case-insensitive matching. For now (small leaderboard) fine, but better is a unique partial index on name_key + an indexed query: db.leaderboard.find({'name_key': key, 'mode': {'$ne': 'guest'}}). Worth a P2.

Guest expiry is query-time only (no TTL index). Expired guest docs accumulate in the collection until something else cleans them. Cheap fix: add a MongoDB TTL index on expires_at parsed as a real date instead of an ISO string. Currently expires_at is stored as an ISO string, which prevents native TTL. Consider storing as datetime so a TTL index can auto-purge.
secrets.compare_digest used correctly for admin token (constant-time). Good.
Sanitizer _sanitize correctly strips owner_token, name_key, expires_at, and _id from public responses. No leakage observed in GET.
Frontend Leaderboard.jsx AdminPanel keeps its token in sessionStorage only (per spec), confirmed via runtime check. Good.
Frontend Play.jsx setSuggestions([]) before each save attempt + clears suggestions when a chip is clicked. Good UX.
Minor: in api.js, getOwnerToken uses Math.random() as fallback when window.crypto?.randomUUID is missing -- acceptable as a non-security identifier.
test_credentials: Admin token cf-admin-7Qx2Lm9Tv (X-Admin-Token header / admin-token-input). Read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: All test rows TEST_v0261_*, TEST_iter5_*, TEST_conf_*, TEST_guest_* were created by tests and self-cleaned via admin delete. Also cleaned residual entries left by earlier iterations (TEST_iter3, TEST_v025_player x2, TEST_conf_01414b). Leaderboard left tidy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression command: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py /app/backend/tests/test_v026.py /app/backend/tests/test_v0261_leaderboard.py (30 tests) plus python /app/backend/tests/test_scoring.py (5/5). Admin token lives in /app/backend/.env ADMIN_TOKEN and /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Frontend conflict UI test requires playing a full 3-round session first (save-section only renders on /play after sessionDone) -- and the conflict-name save must be attempted BEFORE any successful official save in the same component instance, because submitted=true permanently hides save-section. Pre-seed the conflicting name under a DIFFERENT owner_token via API before opening the UI. window.confirm is used for delete-my-score and admin-delete; register page.once('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.create_task(d.accept())) before each click. Admin token MUST live only in sessionStorage (cf_admin_token); verifying localStorage is null is part of the contract.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The single transient test failure during this iteration was a test-script issue: after a successful official save, Play.jsx sets submitted=true and unmounts the save-section, so subsequent fill on leaderboard-name-input timed out. Fixed by attempting the conflict save FIRST on a fresh session (conflict returns status='conflict' without flipping submitted).
